summary: Collect bounded local measurements and summarize production windows for per-home performance and reliability reviews.
inputs: HomeBrain operational health, MongoDB, and runtime revision
outputs: Five-minute measurements and admin-only window summaries at /api/resources/measurements
side_effects: Writes one local MongoDB document per interval with 35-day expiry and probes paired local Alexa brokers.

environment: Supported Node.js and locked server dependencies
MongoDB and optional Linux procfs/sysfs counters
Isolated MongoDB 8 fixture on port 33337 for integration verification
